task.title: Add global actions section to VSCode extension
task.description: Add a collapsible "GLOBAL ACTIONS" section to the VSCode extension sidebar that provides quick access to project-wide commands like kanban-map-product and kanban-map-engineering. These actions don't belong to any specific task but are useful for documentation management.
task.problem: The kanban-map-product and kanban-map-engineering commands have no UI access in VSCode. Users must know the exact command names and use the command palette to find them. This creates friction when switching between coding and documentation mapping tasks, as users must leave the visual workflow to access these features.
task.value: Provides discoverability for documentation commands directly in the sidebar. Users see available global actions alongside their task list, maintaining a consistent visual workflow. The pattern also establishes an extensible foundation for future non-task actions without cluttering the task view.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the VSCode extension is active in a workspace with .kanban/ folder When the user views the sidebar Then a collapsible "GLOBAL ACTIONS" section appears below the existing views
Given the "GLOBAL ACTIONS" section is visible When the user expands it Then they see flat list items for "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs" And each item has an appropriate ThemeIcon
Given the user clicks "Map Product Docs" When the action executes Then a terminal opens with the claude "/kanban-map-product" command
Given the user clicks "Map Engineering Docs" When the action executes Then a terminal opens with the claude "/kanban-map-engineering" command
Given the user uses keyboard navigation When they focus on a global action item Then they can activate it with Enter key
